title: Short-Sale Maintenance Carry
content:
# Short-sale maintenance carry — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction

On the payoff case of an Approved Short Sale Payoff requested by the borrower of record, the short-sale maintenance carry enters the short-sale accrual basis.

The short-sale maintenance carry is figured from the latest inspection result recorded on the loan's occupancy profile under the Occupancy and Residency Certification product, read with the vacant-property securing setting of the maturity case's plan under the Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases product, and only where that plan permits vacant-property securing: when the result found the home vacant and the loan's property type is FHA-approved condominium or planned unit development, it is the flat USD 120.00 association maintenance charge; when it found the home vacant and the property is of any other type, or is a Summit loan, which records no property type, it is USD 55.00 of monthly maintenance for each of the short-sale months of vacancy; any other result, no result, or a plan that does not permit vacant-property securing carries nothing (0.00).

The short-sale months of vacancy are the whole calendar months from the occupancy profile's non-occupancy date to the statement date, not below 0, plus one; a profile with no non-occupancy date counts one month. A whole calendar month is complete when the same day of a later month is reached.

Where several inspection results on the occupancy profile share the latest effective date, a vacant finding among them counts as the latest result, and otherwise an unable-to-determine finding does. An unable-to-determine result carries no maintenance charge under this rule.

| Hypothetical case (securing permitted) | Short-sale maintenance carry |
|---|---|
| Vacant; planned unit development | USD 120.00 |
| Vacant; two-to-four-unit HECM; non-occupancy date 3 March, statement date 2 May (1 whole month, plus one) | USD 110.00 |
| Vacant; non-occupancy date after the statement date (0 months, plus one) | USD 55.00 |
| Unable to determine | nothing |

The cases are hypothetical.
